title: Awesome Jev decision model directory
scope: Independent publisher releases and model-card summaries. Declared licenses and reported capabilities are not independently reproduced results or a universal ranking.

models.title: OneJev1.5-27B
models.en: 27B full fine-tune for text, image and video decisions, served through qev. Training includes public benchmark training splits; reported scores cover the public suite, and Jev comparison numbers are imported rather than a matched multimodal rerun.
models.zh: 面向文本、图像和视频决策的 27B 全量微调模型，通过 qev 提供服务。训练包含公开基准的训练切分；所报分数覆盖公共评测，Jev 对照数字来自已发表结果，并非同条件的多模态重测。

models.title: d1-omni-600M
models.by: Liquid AI · LFM Open License v1.0
models.en: 587M encoder for text with images or up to 30 seconds of English speech; one request cannot mix both media. Only text uses fitted temperatures. Image requests cap text at 896 tokens; custom code and the LFM Open License apply.
models.zh: 587M 编码器，支持文本配合图像或最长 30 秒的英语语音，单次请求不能同时使用两种媒体。仅文本使用拟合温度；图像请求的文本上限为 896 个 token，需使用自定义代码并遵循 LFM Open License。

models.title: Torchcast Decision 27B
models.en: Merged LoRA decision model with a CUDA serving package; weights are noncommercial, serving code Apache-2.0. Text-only, checkpoint-selected results use Decision Index 0.2.1; long states and more than 26 options change the inference path.
models.zh: 合并 LoRA 权重的决策模型，附 CUDA 服务包；权重限非商业用途，服务代码为 Apache-2.0。文本评测使用 Decision Index 0.2.1 且参与检查点选择；长状态或超过 26 个选项会改变推理路径。

models.title: tasksource-decider-nano
models.en: 150M joint cross-encoder with shared-state tree attention and choice/noul outputs. Rejects pairs above 8,192 tokens; training includes public benchmark training splits. Reported speed and public-suite scores use the documented A10 setup.
models.zh: 150M 联合交叉编码器，通过树形注意力共享状态，输出 choice／noul。超过 8,192 个 token 的配对会被拒绝；训练包含公开基准的训练切分，所报速度和公共评测分数使用文档所述 A10 配置。

models.title: Saracura PT-BR 4B
models.en: Brazilian Portuguese Kev adapter and pointer head. Source-matched tests and two-fold human-set calibration do not establish general Portuguese performance; private email-tuned results belong to an unreleased model. Use the documented 2,048-token state setting for comparisons.
models.zh: 面向巴西葡萄牙语的 Kev 适配器和指针头。同源测试及人工标注集上的两折校准不能证明通用葡语能力；私有邮件微调结果属于未发布模型。比较时需使用文档所述 2,048-token 状态设置。

models.title: Perplexity Decider v1.2 27B
models.en: 27B text/image model with joint question readouts: questions can affect one another. Public-suite training exposure and grouping affect comparisons. Anonymous Hub metadata and a weight HEAD were accessible on 18 Oct; the card still instructs private access.
models.zh: 27B 文本／图像模型，联合读取多个问题，问题间可相互影响。公开评测训练数据的使用与问题分组会影响比较。10 月 18 日匿名元数据与权重 HEAD 请求可访问，但模型卡仍写着需私有访问权限。

models.title: Amos 1 large
models.en: English typed decisions with image inputs; distinguish zero-shot results from train-split prior fitting, and public-only Decision Index results from the full evaluation.
models.zh: 支持图像输入的英文类型化决策模型；应区分零样本结果与按训练切分拟合先验的结果，以及 Decision Index 公共部分与完整评测。

models.title: KnowLine-35B-A3B-Gen1
models.en: English/Chinese MoE decision checkpoint; public-suite checkpoint selection, disclosed task/source overlap and self-run calibration ranges constrain comparisons with independent held-out evaluations.
models.zh: 英中文 MoE 决策检查点；公开评测选点、披露的任务／来源重叠与自行计算的校准区间，限制了它与独立留出评测的比较。

models.title: Lychee-27B
models.en: Noncommercial Qwen-derived typed-decision model with publisher-reported public-suite results; requests exceeding context or GPU-memory limits are documented as rejected rather than truncated.
models.zh: 按非商业许可发布的 Qwen 派生决策模型，公共评测结果由发布者报告；文档说明超出上下文或显存限制时拒绝请求，而非截断。

models.title: Span-02
models.en: Multimodal decision model with a dedicated Blackwell Rust/CUDA runtime and optional reasoning; distinguish default serving from deterministic index settings and output-specific confidence semantics.
models.zh: 使用专用 Blackwell Rust/CUDA 运行库、可选择生成推理的多模态决策模型；需区分默认服务与确定性榜单配置，以及不同输出类型的置信度语义。

models.title: AudioJev checkpoint
models.en: One released AudioJev training seed with a Qwen Research license; original-order scores disclose audio-source overlap and are distinct from the paper’s three-seed averages.
models.zh: 按 Qwen Research 许可发布的单训练种子 AudioJev 检查点；原始选项顺序得分披露了音频来源重叠，与论文三种子均值不同。

models.title: ufakzeka-karar
models.en: Turkish typed-decision checkpoint with shipped temperature scaling. Its card flags test-informed training and worsening support-task calibration; benchmark results are not blind.
models.zh: 土耳其语类型化决策检查点，附温度缩放参数；模型卡标注训练参考了测试结果，并报告客服任务的校准恶化，基准结果并非盲测。

models.title: Jeva-4B
models.en: Author checkpoint with backbone, adapter and decision-head files. The inspected card declares no model license; weights have not been loaded or tested by this project.
models.zh: 作者发布的检查点包，含骨干、适配器和决策头文件；所查模型卡未声明模型许可，本项目未加载或测试权重。

models.title: Laya
models.en: An encoder-based decision family with English, multilingual, and workflow-specific checkpoints.
models.zh: 基于编码器的决策模型家族，包含英语、多语言与工作流专用检查点。

models.title: Kev-4B
models.en: A Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA adapter and pointer head for decisions over documents and typed questions.
models.zh: 基于 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 的 LoRA 适配器与指针头，面向文档与类型化问题的决策。

models.title: Bespoke Nimble 9B v3
models.en: A Qwen3.5-9B LoRA adapter returning candidate probabilities. Released under a noncommercial license.
models.zh: 返回候选项概率的 Qwen3.5-9B LoRA 适配器；采用非商业用途许可。

models.title: Intern-Decision-4B
models.en: A decision-tuned Qwen checkpoint with a structured inference wrapper and image support.
models.zh: 经过决策微调的 Qwen 检查点，提供结构化推理封装并支持图片输入。

models.title: GLiNER2.5-Decide
models.en: A 340M English classifier with runtime label sets and single-label or multi-label decisions.
models.zh: 340M 英语分类模型，支持调用时指定标签集合，以及单标签和多标签决策。

models.title: d3
models.en: A text, image, and video decision model with Choice, Yes/No, and Score outputs.
models.zh: 支持文本、图片与视频的决策模型，提供 Choice、Yes/No 与 Score 输出。

models.title: Clef
models.en: A multimodal model with a joint schema head, returning probabilities over allowed answers.
models.zh: 使用联合 schema 预测头的多模态模型，返回允许答案集合上的概率。
